name: Shell command execution behind a confirmed hidden parameter

then.hypothesis: Ask the confirmed hidden parameter one question: did a SHELL run a command appended to its value? The payload is one command terminator plus an arithmetic echo (;echo $((1339*1339)), percent-encoded because curl does not encode a query for us) and the only oracle is the exact marker 1792921 standing alone in the response body -- the payload echoed back, encoded or decoded, proves only that the request arrived, and the same seven digits inside a trace id prove nothing, so neither is a hit. There is deliberately no delay oracle: one action yields one observation, so there is no recorded baseline to measure a duration against. The probe stops at the echo -- it holds no session inside the target and runs nothing further there. The has_param gate guarantees a query string, so the parameter is appended with & and rendered through hyp.param; obs_url carries the same value so the minted finding has a url the OOB validator can re-send through.
